CODE
2.3.20. 
Proof 
With respect to third parties, ownership by each of the spouses of property which is not personal property must be established, in the absence of an inventory or in the absence of possession satisfying the conditions of Article 3.21, by deeds with a date certain, documents issued by a public authority or entries in registers, documents or records required by law or established by custom and regularly kept or drawn up.
Between spouses, proof of ownership of the same property or of claims may be furnished by any means of proof.
